resources.string: We want you to see the data sources behind each signal. StratAperture organizes public news, global news indexes, available fast-moving signals, and selected policy research.
We monitor a curated set of public news feeds and indexes. Source labels help separate direct reporting from aggregated or derived signals.
Global news index used as an aggregation signal, not a single publisher.
Optional fast-moving signal source, enabled only when credentials are configured.
Research uses a curated weekly dataset of think tank and policy sources. The included source list may evolve.
The app collects items from monitored sources, groups similar signals by topic, region, or crisis theme, and reduces duplicate or overlapping coverage where possible.
This is not a complete index of all news or research.
Source availability can change, and temporary gaps may occur.
Open original sources before making important judgments.
